crossRefs.note: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?
For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’
Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great…
then you will delight yourself in Yahweh, and I will make you to ride on the high places of the earth, and I will feed…
For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,
Surely then you will lift up your face without spot; Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear:
To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.
Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should…
because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

translations.web: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.
translations.bsb: Surely then you will delight in the Almighty and lift up your face to God.
translations.kjv: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.
translations.asv: For then shalt thou delight thyself in the Almighty, And shalt lift up thy face unto God.
